title_en: Notice of the State Council on Issues Concerning the Application of Interim Regulations on Value-Added Tax, Consumption Tax, and Business Tax by Foreign-Invested Enterprises and Foreign Enterprises

articles.content_en:
II. Concerning the Handling of Increased Tax Burden after Foreign-Invested Enterprises Switch to Value-Added Tax, Consumption Tax, and Business Tax
(1) For foreign-invested enterprises established before December 31, 1993, if the tax burden increases due to the switch to value-added tax, consumption tax, and business tax, the enterprise may submit an application, and upon examination and approval by the tax authorities, a refund of the additional tax paid due to the increased tax burden shall be granted within the approved term of operation, provided that the maximum period shall not exceed five years; for those without a term of operation, upon application by the enterprise and approval by the tax authorities, a refund of the aforementioned additional tax paid shall be granted within a period not exceeding five years at the maximum.
(2) For foreign-invested enterprises that pay both value-added tax and consumption tax, the portion of tax paid exceeding the original tax burden shall be refunded respectively as value-added tax and consumption tax in proportion to the value-added tax and consumption tax paid.
(3) For products produced by foreign-invested enterprises that are directly exported or sold to export enterprises for export, tax refund shall be processed in a single instance in accordance with the provisions of the Interim Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Value-Added Tax, based on the customs export declaration and the tax payment certificate.
(4) Tax refund applications by foreign-invested enterprises due to increased tax burden shall, in principle, be processed once after the year-end; for those with a significant increase in tax burden, an application for provisional refund may be made quarterly, with settlement after the year-end.
(5) Matters concerning the refund of value-added tax and consumption tax shall be handled by the State Taxation Bureau system, and treasuries at all levels shall carefully examine and strictly control them. The calculation of the refund amount, the procedures for applying for and approving the refund, etc., shall be separately formulated by the State Administration of Taxation.
(6) Matters concerning the refund of business tax shall be prescribed by the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government.

III. Concerning Tax Issues on Sino-Foreign Cooperative Exploitation of Petroleum Resources
Crude oil and natural gas extracted from Sino-foreign cooperative oil (gas) fields shall be subject to value-added tax in kind at a tax rate of 5%, and a royalty shall be levied in accordance with the current provisions, while resource tax shall not be levied for the time being. When calculating and collecting value-added tax, the input tax amount shall not be deducted. No tax refund shall be granted for the export of crude oil and natural gas.
The offshore self-operated oil fields of China National Offshore Oil Corporation shall implement the above provisions by analogy.
This notice shall come into force as of January 1, 1994.
